notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Important Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now hire soldiers at early levels.
[*] Expenditures for hired soldiers became clearer.
[*] Lufulus's Wisdom are now more balanced and able to give up.
[*] Visual Enhancements
[*] Performance Optimizations
[*] Hired soldiers do not disappear suddenly.
[*] Hired soldiers and their power now also increase your game score.
[*] New Potions, Passives, and Items
[*] Performance Improvements
[*] New Quests
[*] Optimized Banking
[/list]

[h2]Small Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now, only the player can attack Lufulus' Wisdoms.
[*] Understandability Improvements
[*] Power Balances
[*] Grammar errors are corrected.
[/list]

[h2]With this major update, Lufulus' Creatures Mobile is out! You can find it on Google Play.[/h2]

[h3]Discord: https://discord.gg/ZXRQAws[/h3]

notes.title: Full Version Update
notes.notes:
[u][h3]Changes[/h3][/u]
[list][*][b]broccoli and bonus plusses now much more efficient.[/b] These bonusses are dropped from enemies when you are fighting. Now, they are important part of fighting mechanics. Some of them are smaller and less efficient. The only way to drop stronger ones is killing your opponents.

[*] Items can be dismantled into materials twice as much as their development level. For example, an +3 item provides 6 materials.

[*] You can now merge 6 materials to make a better material.

[*] Items can be upgraded to +11.

[*] Time goes faster.

[*] Normal merchants now sell items that are +2.

[*] In the last wave of a wave area, if it is not killed before,\nthe captain attacks. Captain creature grants improved loot.

[*] The waves will become 2 times harder than before,\nafter their captain is killed. Captainless wave locations give twice as much experience.
[/list]

[u][h3]Small Changes[/h3][/u]
[list][*] Functionality of the bank has been improved.

[*] There are new creatures and quests.

[*] A new ability for enemies has been added.

[*] New environmental decorations were added and graphic arrangements were made.

[*] Hotfixes

[*] Performance(FPS) is improved.

[*] Items that are superior in power now require better material than normal.

[*] The difficulty of the missions has been adjusted according to the levels.

[*] New NPCs are added to Belingfur Castle.

[*] Lufulus' Wisdoms are easier to be killed.

[*] Usage of windows is improved.

[*] A new page called "Loot" has been added to your Item Bag. You cannot move items to this page. It makes your item bag larger and preserves your item arrangement.
[/list]

notes.title: Lufulus' Creatures v1.0 is Released
notes.notes:
After a long early access, the game has reached the full version.
However, it will continue to be updated and will become more intense with additional features and various items. If you share your ideas and feedback, I can make the related changes in the game.

If you encounter a problem, you can get answers quickly by writing to the community section.
Hope you will have fun!

notes.title: Lufulus' Creatures is Available on Early Access
notes.notes:
Lufulus' Creatures has been released on Early Access. The game is ready to play. I will carefully read your feedback and make the necessary changes.
[list]
[*] Because of the early development stage of the game, save files may become unusable after an update.
[*] The second half of the game is quite missing, I hope it will be completed quickly. I am hardly working on this issue. It will be completed day by day.
[*] New quests, items, locations, and creatures will be added. Different combinations of game elements will provide a reason to play game from the start.
[/list]
I suggest you check out the Early Access description.
I hope you will have fun!
